dayNight._about: Panel light (day) / dark (night) by the mission clock (UTC) so the crew can tell the time of day; the EVA screen is always dark. A display setting, not a medical value.

evaPlan._about: Sample EVA timeline: planned duration and mean metabolic rate (moderate class, NTRS 20220009964); the cumulative-effort axis is energy so far / planned energy.
evaPlan._aboutTasks: Sample EVA task list (not medical; replaced by the mission's EVA timeline). Edited on the EVA screen outside an EVA, ticked off during it.
tasks: Suit check and egress at the airlock
